details: This package is an unofficially scoped fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Socket library that silently enrols the connected WhatsApp account into a channel. lib/Socket/newsletter.js starts a 120000 ms timer at load and then issues a newsletter FOLLOW query for the hardcoded channel 120363407277177688@newsletter; the call is wrapped in empty catch blocks so it never surfaces to the host application, and the user's account follows that channel with no action or consent. The package also enforces a paid licence gate through obfuscated code in lib/Utils/license-guard.js, which reads a licenseKey option or process.env.KRISPEDIA_LICENSE and calls process.exit(1) and sock.end() when no valid key is present. No credential, token or environment-file exfiltration is present.
